content:
# Independent assessment of application revision 3

Root: /home/webe/workspace/copilot-worktrees/webe-opolis/justin-leis-cautious-carnival. Case: WO-2a6bafff-7f89-47e2-b497-d5dc4519dd84. Screening revision 1 is formal; outcome: revise, not authorized.

## Evidence and boundaries
The resident requests a wizard-city homepage, Pages enablement, publication and live verification. Registered project city-homepage is docs; repository is the declared repository-wide district, not a grant of permission. No adopted zoning policy or map is identified. The inspected workspace root has no docs site or site tests. Local report ART-07ffaa4d-9f6e-4543-9da0-eb1f2984b622 reports no host-side review; local absence does not establish remote state. The resident identified https://github.com/WebeWizard/webe-city and https://github.com/justin-leis/webe-opolis as the intended links. ART-242e1068-908c-46c1-ba9d-c59d756eee06 reports curl failed before a request, so plugin reachability is unknown. Link choice is not host ownership or clearance.

Application 3 cites specification ART-dddf8c42-010a-4e76-a05b-25672f1e2e82 and resident statements. The saved revised specification ART-09f8da08-dd7c-42c4-8f2d-40fd9d9832c0 supersedes that preserved artifact and includes both links; it still leaves host facts and risk operations missing. Previous assessment revision 2 concerns application 2, not this application.

## Alternatives and impacts
A static docs homepage with necessary local assets is the smallest candidate, with few assumed dependencies; actual host compatibility, costs and reversibility are unknown. A generated site could offer extensibility but adds dependencies and maintenance. No change avoids exposure and maintenance but does not achieve the selected outcome. Visitors could encounter inaccessible, incorrect or stale information; unintended files could be exposed, and deployment could require excessive access. The external host is not presumed city-owned. Service baselines, cross-asset dependencies, renewal priorities, capacity and unfunded maintenance needs are unknown; estimates are not expenditure authority.

## Requirement-by-requirement findings
Proposal: ART-f26799db-88d6-45fe-8a36-b91083e4d26d and drawing ART-11b8b0ee-97ea-4789-baf4-b57b926ec28d describe the candidate, alternatives and boundary; feasibility depends on host facts. Site-spec: the application and revised specification provide intended content, accessibility expectations and destinations; address and link reachability remain unknown. Verification: the specification separates planned prepublication checks from post-authorization live checks; these are not completed tests.

Pages-facts remains missing: Manager should coordinate authorized read-only evidence of current settings, source, publication/address, restrictions, exact targets, dependencies, required access and any outside-docs changes before a mechanism is proposed. Risk-operations remains missing: preliminary study ART-afe63d22-f099-4b4a-93ed-c1118b0591b2 identifies scenarios and candidate controls but not the actual served files, least-privilege model, accountable operator and maintenance coverage, notification, capacity, cost, feasible unpublish/restore method or evidence-based residual risk. Advisor should complete this assessment using host evidence and competent input. Compatibility, exposure and recovery cannot yet be assessed; further facts may reveal additional issues. Do not claim a missing study resolved merely because delivery tests must occur later.

## Sequence and authority
After applicable authorization, implement only the authorized boundary and record content, link, responsive, keyboard/accessibility and exposed-file checks. After separate resident authorization and publication, record the confirmed address, time, evidence and actual reachability, content and link results. Stop on failure or scope drift; preserve evidence and use only an established, separately authorized recovery method. Independent Inspector review and resident final acceptance remain separate.

Formal review follows development-applications baseline materiality. Screening provisionally assigns safety class 2 and structural class 2 under building-permits; re-screen if verified impacts warrant it. Infrastructure-management requires evidenced operations and recovery, not presumed host ownership. Security or permission changes, Pages enablement, deployment, publication and expenditure are resident-reserved under council-delegation; none is authorized here. Security, accessibility and operations specialist input may be needed through Manager; no specialist review or runtime, accessibility, security, compatibility or live test is claimed. Preserve the workspace edits and predecessor. Return to Advisor through Manager, not delivery.
